mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood supply the same muscles tied earlier ideas together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but predictable; those placements felt more like assembly than a meaningful puzzle.

surprise.text: The explanation that nerves, blood vessels and the food pipe cross between chest and abdomen by their own routes helped me understand how the regions connect.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The lymph network fitting at the chest made sense because its existing route returns to a vein.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a new body connection. This finale was a useful recap, but much of the fitting was predictable.
